$comment: Copy to polycode.config.json (cwd) or ~/.config/polycode/config.json. Providers: openai | google | xai | muse | nvidia | qwen | anthropic. Run: poly --models. Contributor/training-tier ids require allowTrainingTiers: true.
system: You are polycode, a terminal coding agent. Be concise. Use tools to inspect and edit the project. Prefer the smallest change that solves the task.

routing.$comment: strategy 'heuristic' (free) or 'model' (a cheap model picks the tier each turn). classifier defaults to the cheap tier.

sandbox.$comment: kind 'local' (host shell) or 'docker' (shell runs in an isolated container; file edits still land in the project). Use 'docker' for untrusted/hosted use.

session.$comment: Grok-shaped two-pass compaction. Auto-runs at this % of the model context window. /compact [focus] always runs. Cheap-tier provider writes the prefix summary.

permissions.$comment: Claude-style patterns. Deny wins. .env / .git / .polycode are always protected outside yolo.

hooks.$comment: Commands run through the sandbox. Nonzero PreToolUse / UserPromptSubmit exit denies. Vars: $TOOL_NAME $FILE $TOOL_INPUT $PROMPT $OUTPUT $SUBAGENT_TYPE. Events: SessionStart UserPromptSubmit PreToolUse PostToolUse SubagentStart SubagentStop Stop SessionEnd.

hosted.$comment: poly --serve. mode: plan (local) or acceptEdits (docker). yolo requires --insecure. Rate limit is per client IP.

plugins.$comment: Discovered from .polycode/plugins/<name>/ and ~/.config/polycode/plugins/. disable skips names.

mcp.$comment: deferSchemas (default true): stub MCP JSON schemas until mcp_search or first call. allowRegistrySpawns: never let mcp.json run npx/npm (public registry execute).

statusLine.$comment: Idle TUI status. Tokens: $model $mode $route $sandbox $ctx $ctx_seg $sum $sum_seg $mcp $mcp_seg $cost $cost_seg $cwd. Optional command runs through the sandbox.

providers.$comment: allow: omit to permit every catalog id. custom: extra OpenAI-compat endpoints (on-prem NIM, vLLM) with no code change. NVIDIA_BASE_URL / MUSE_BASE_URL / QWEN_BASE_URL override hosted URLs.
